items.title: Tom McIntosh — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: She yelled, “Thomas, I told you to go to the store boy!”

ctx.x: It’ll come back? Okay. When you mention the music you listen to-­

Oh, oh, oh, I started to tell you…my mother told me to go to the store. I happened to be listening to the radio, and it was a classical arrangement of “Danny Boy.” Everyone used to sing it, but now I’m listening to it orchestral and there are no words. I said, “Man, that is so beautiful Wow!” I got so entranced that I forgot what my mother had asked me to do. She yelled, “Thomas, I told you to go to the store boy!” I said, “Okay, mom,” and I tore myself away from the record, away from the recording. But, I knew I…
Did you ever listen to folks like William Grant Still, Marion Anderson, any of those folks while your were young?
